_: Web copy for the /compare/ pages. Keyed by the post slug in posts.json without its number prefix. name = what the comparison is called in titles; h1 = page heading; desc = meta description (140-160 chars); intro = short paragraphs above the table; pick = where to start; bundle = matching collection id, if any.

time-capsule.name: Nishane Time Capsule
time-capsule.desc: Kredo, Tempfluo, Papilefiko, Deziro and Tero side by side: notes, intensity, season, retail and Velvet Volute decant prices. Nishane's Time Capsule, in Ottawa.
intro: Five extraits, one collection, five different moods. Nishane built the Time Capsule around big ideas (belief, time, the butterfly effect, desire, earth) and handed each one to a different master perfumer.
They share a house and a bottle. They don't share a personality. This table is the short version. Tap a name for the full story.
time-capsule.pick: Not sure where to start? Tempfluo is the easiest to love. Kredo if you lean leather and oud, Deziro if you want fresh, Tero if you want warm and earthy, Papilefiko if you want something nobody else is wearing.

born-in-roma.name: Valentino Born in Roma
born-in-roma.desc: Green Stravaganza, Yellow Dream, Coral Fantasy and Purple Melancholia compared: notes, intensity, season and decant prices. Valentino Born in Roma, from Ottawa.
intro: Four takes on one city. Valentino's Born in Roma line is built for easy wear, and every flanker leans a different direction: green and fresh, sweet and sunny, warm and smooth, moody and late.
Same bottle shape, four different days. Here's how they line up.
born-in-roma.pick: Start with Coral Fantasy if you want one for everything. Green Stravaganza for the office, Yellow Dream for summer, Purple Melancholia for nights out.

leather-suede.name: Leather & Suede
leather-suede.desc: Tom Ford Ombré Leather and Tuscan Leather, Nishane Suède et Safran and Sospiro Erba Leather compared: notes, intensity, season and decant prices in Ottawa.
intro: Leather is a mood, not a note. It can be broken-in and easy, bold and loud, tailored and soft, or sunlit and fruity. These four cover the whole range.
Two from Tom Ford, one from Nishane, one from Sospiro. All four make up the Leather & Suede Collection if you'd rather try them together.
leather-suede.pick: Ombré Leather is the easiest first leather. Tuscan Leather if you want to be noticed, Suède et Safran if you want polish, Erba Leather if you want leather that still feels like summer.

tom-ford.name: Tom Ford
tom-ford.desc: Tom Ford Noir, Noir Extreme, Ombré Leather and Oud Minérale compared: four after-dark essentials. Notes, intensity, season, retail and decant prices, from Ottawa.
intro: Tom Ford built Noir around a man with two sides: the polished one everyone meets, and the darker one very few get to know. These four belong to the second one.
Noir is the dressed-up original, Noir Extreme the creamier encore, Ombré Leather the jacket you never take off, Oud Minérale the coastline after dark.
tom-ford.pick: Ombré Leather if you're new to the house. Noir Extreme if you want sweet and seductive, Noir if you want old-school elegance, Oud Minérale if you want something nobody else in the room is wearing.

boozy.name: The Boozy Collection
boozy.h1: Last call, bottled: the boozy ones, compared
boozy.desc: Margiela Jazz Club, Nishane Fan Your Flames and Nefs, and Givenchy Gentleman Réserve Privée compared: rum, whisky, honey and smoke. Notes and decant prices.
intro: Tonight's tab. Jazz Club is the rum in a dim Brooklyn bar, Fan Your Flames is the coconut rum out by the fire, Réserve Privée is the one glass of good whisky, and Nefs is the honeyed nightcap with rose and oud.
Four different bars. Same closing time.
boozy.pick: Jazz Club is the safe first pour. Fan Your Flames if you want sweet and social, Réserve Privée if you want polished, Nefs if you want the richest thing on the menu.

vanilla.name: Vanilla
vanilla.h1: Four ways to wear vanilla, compared
vanilla.desc: Nishane Ani, Parfums de Marly Althaïr, Armani I Will and Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir compared: one note, four moods. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Vanilla is the fruit of an orchid that blooms for a single day, and almost everywhere it grows it has to be pollinated by hand. Perfumers treat it like a lead role. Here it plays four.
Ani spices it with blue ginger, Althaïr gilds it with praline and cinnamon, I Will keeps it hushed over lavender, Le Male Elixir drenches it in honey and tonka.
vanilla.pick: Ani if you want the famous one. Althaïr if you want it rich and polished, I Will for every day, Le Male Elixir if you want to be noticed from across the room.

nishane-x.name: Nishane X Collection
nishane-x.desc: Nishane Hundred Silent Ways X, Fan Your Flames X and Wulong Cha X compared: three classics rewritten for the house's 10th anniversary. Notes and decant prices.
intro: An X usually crosses something out. At Nishane it marks a second draft. For its tenth anniversary the house handed three of its classics to perfumers with one brief: keep the idea, change the mood.
Hundred Silent Ways X says it after dark, Fan Your Flames X walks the original through an herb garden, Wulong Cha X lets the oolong cool and blossom.
nishane-x.pick: Wulong Cha X for daytime, Fan Your Flames X for everything after, Hundred Silent Ways X when you want to be remembered.

tea-x-flames.name: Tea 'X' Flames
tea-x-flames.h1: The originals vs the X: Fan Your Flames and Wulong Cha, compared
tea-x-flames.desc: Nishane Fan Your Flames, Fan Your Flames X, Wulong Cha and Wulong Cha X compared side by side: two icons and their remixes. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Two Nishane icons, each standing next to its tenth-anniversary remix. Fan Your Flames is a bonfire of rum, coconut and tobacco; its X throws thyme and mastic on the flames. Wulong Cha is oolong steeped with bergamot and fig; its X opens the tea-house window to green tea and magnolia.
Read across the row to hear how an original changes when the house hands it to a new perfumer.
tea-x-flames.pick: Fan Your Flames if you want the one everybody talks about, its X if sweet usually gets too much for you. Wulong Cha for an easy everyday, Wulong Cha X when you want it cooler and more floral.

coffeehouse.name: The Coffeehouse Collection
coffeehouse.desc: Margiela Coffee Break, Claude Marsal Or Noir Café, Valentino Green Stravaganza and Ferragamo Uomo Signature compared: four coffee scents, notes and decant prices.
intro: Four orders at one counter. Coffee Break is the milky latte on a cold Stockholm morning. Or Noir Café is the sweet one for the table, toffee and cinnamon over the espresso. Green Stravaganza takes its cup out to a sunny terrace. Uomo Signature has the seat by the window with the last cup of the day.
Coffee in perfume can be soft, sweet, bright or dressed up. This table shows which is which.
coffeehouse.pick: Coffee Break for the softest, Or Noir Café for the sweetest, Green Stravaganza for daytime, Uomo Signature for date night.

flower-and-stone.name: The Flower & Stone Collection
flower-and-stone.desc: Tom Ford Café Rose, Black Orchid and Oud Minérale with Hermès Terre d'Hermès Intense compared: two blossoms, two stones. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Some flowers grow out of rock. Café Rose is a Turkish rose steeped in dark coffee. Black Orchid blooms out of black truffle and patchouli, dark as soil after rain.
Then the stones. Terre d'Hermès Intense is earth after a fire, pepper and coffee over lava stone. Oud Minérale is the shoreline, salt drying on warm rock.
flower-and-stone.pick: Black Orchid if you want the boldest. Café Rose for a romantic evening, Terre d'Hermès Intense for an everyday signature, Oud Minérale if you want cool and unexpected.

saffron.name: The Saffron Collection
saffron.h1: Red gold: four saffron fragrances, compared
saffron.desc: Nishane Suède et Safran, Tom Ford Noir Extreme, MFK Baccarat Rouge 540 and Versace Eros Najim compared: saffron four ways. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Each thread of saffron is picked by hand from a crocus that gives up only three, which is why it costs more by weight than any other spice. These four each put that red gold to work in their own way.
Suède et Safran sews it into soft suede, Noir Extreme melts it into a creamy kulfi accord, Baccarat Rouge 540 lets it glow over ambergris, Eros Najim burns it down to caramel and oud.
saffron.pick: Baccarat Rouge 540 if you want the one people stop you to ask about. Suède et Safran for refined, Noir Extreme for seductive, Eros Najim for loud and late.

holiday-spice.name: The Holiday Spice Collection
holiday-spice.desc: Valentino Yellow Dream, Nishane Tero and Ani, and Xerjoff Erba Gold compared: gingerbread, caramel, ginger and golden fruit. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: It's the middle of December and the oven has been on since noon. Yellow Dream is the gingerbread cooling on the rack, Tero the salted caramel someone keeps stirring, Ani the ginger tea steaming on the counter.
Erba Gold takes the last seat at the table, bringing orange and warm spice in from the cold.
holiday-spice.pick: Ani if you want the crowd favourite. Tero for the deepest and warmest, Yellow Dream for playful, Erba Gold if you want the season bright instead of heavy.

erba.name: The Erba Collection
erba.desc: Xerjoff Erba Gold and Erba Pura with Sospiro Erba Leather compared: three summers from Turin. Notes, intensity, retail and Velvet Volute decant prices.
intro: Erba is Italian for grass, the green that pushes up through the old stone of Turin. Two sister houses there, Xerjoff and Sospiro, turned the word into a small dynasty of sunshine.
Erba Gold came first, all pear, melon and warm spice. Erba Pura made the name famous with its Mediterranean fruit bowl. Erba Leather lined the fruit with soft leather.
erba.pick: Erba Pura if you want the famous one. Erba Gold for something warmer and rarer, Erba Leather if you want the fruit with a little edge.

fruity-with-depth.name: Fruity, with depth
fruity-with-depth.h1: Fruity, with depth: four grown-up fruit scents, compared
fruity-with-depth.desc: Xerjoff Erba Pura and Erba Gold, Nishane Hacivat and Tom Ford Tuscan Leather compared: juicy fruit over something serious. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Fruit in perfume gets a bad reputation, mostly from body sprays. These four are the opposite. The fruit is the first thing you notice, not the only thing.

Erba Pura sets a Mediterranean fruit bowl on amber and musk, Erba Gold warms pear and melon with cardamom, Hacivat grounds pineapple in oakmoss and dry woods, and Tuscan Leather rubs raspberry into rich leather.
fruity-with-depth.pick: Erba Pura if you want the crowd-pleaser. Erba Gold for warmer and rarer, Hacivat for crisp and polished, Tuscan Leather if you want the fruit to have a dark side.

woody-earthy.name: Woody & earthy
woody-earthy.desc: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Intense, Nishane Hacivat and Kredo, and Givenchy Gentleman Réserve Privée compared: four woody, earthy scents. Notes and decant prices.
intro: Every fragrance needs a spine, and woods are it. Cedar is dry and clean, vetiver smells of roots pulled from damp earth, oakmoss is the forest floor, and Terre d'Hermès adds actual stone.
These four are the woodiest in the collection, from mineral and peppery to mossy, whisky-warm and oud-dark.
woody-earthy.pick: Terre d'Hermès Intense for an everyday signature. Hacivat for sharp and fresh, Réserve Privée for smooth evenings, Kredo for quiet depth.

sweet-cozy.name: Sweet & cozy
sweet-cozy.h1: Sweet & cozy: four gourmand fragrances, compared
sweet-cozy.desc: Nishane Fan Your Flames, Parfums de Marly Althaïr, Tom Ford Noir Extreme and Margiela Coffee Break compared: four gourmands. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Gourmand comes from the French word for someone who loves good food, and these four take the name seriously: coconut rum, Bourbon vanilla and praline, a saffron kulfi, a milky coffee.
Done well, sweet doesn't smell like a bakery. It smells like warm skin and the last hour of a good night.
sweet-cozy.pick: Coffee Break for the softest. Althaïr for polished and rich, Fan Your Flames for the most fun, Noir Extreme for date night.

amber-resinous.name: Amber & resinous
amber-resinous.desc: MFK Baccarat Rouge 540, Nishane Nefs, Tom Ford Noir and Versace Eros Najim compared: four golden, glowing ambers. Notes, intensity, retail and decant prices.
intro: Amber isn't a single ingredient. It's a glow perfumers build from resins, a little vanilla and modern materials like ambroxan that echo the ambergris prized for centuries.
These four are the warmest, most radiant things in the collection: crystalline and airy, honeyed and opulent, powdery and refined, or caramel-dark.
amber-resinous.pick: Baccarat Rouge 540 if you want the most recognisable. Noir for refined, Eros Najim for loud, Nefs if you want the richest.

fresh-green.name: Fresh & green
fresh-green.desc: Nishane Deziro, Wulong Cha and Wulong Cha X with Tom Ford Oud Minérale compared: tea, sea air and herbs. Notes, intensity, season and decant prices.
intro: Think of the air after rain, a pot of tea cooling by an open window, sea salt drying on your skin. Fresh and green scents are less about sweetness and more about space.
Deziro brings sea air and mint, the two Wulong Chas brew oolong and green tea, Oud Minérale pairs salt with a surprising smoky oud.
fresh-green.pick: Wulong Cha for an easy everyday. Deziro for summer, Wulong Cha X for something cooler and more floral, Oud Minérale if you want fresh with an edge.

warm-spicy.name: Warm & spicy
warm-spicy.desc: Parfums de Marly Kalan, YSL La Nuit de L'Homme and Nishane Tero and Ani compared: cardamom, pepper, cinnamon and ginger. Notes, intensity and decant prices.
intro: Spices built the old trade routes, and they still bring the heat. Cardamom feels cool and sparkling, black pepper adds bite, cinnamon and ginger glow like embers.
Kalan opens with blood orange and pepper, La Nuit de L'Homme is cardamom whispered close to the skin, Tero stirs cinnamon into salted caramel, Ani warms blue ginger with vanilla.
warm-spicy.pick: La Nuit de L'Homme for the easiest everyday. Kalan for bright and confident, Ani for sweet and addictive, Tero for the deepest and warmest.

floral-powdery.name: Floral & powdery
floral-powdery.desc: Nishane Hundred Silent Ways X and Tempfluo, Tom Ford Café Rose and Dior Homme Intense compared: tuberose, rose, iris and jasmine. Notes and decant prices.
intro: Forget the idea that flowers are only for her. Rose, iris, jasmine and tuberose are some of the most precious materials in perfumery, and some of the most loved men's scents lean on them hard.
Hundred Silent Ways X is tuberose after dark, Café Rose a rose steeped in coffee, Dior Homme Intense the iris that made men's powder cool, Tempfluo jasmine and orange blossom over praline.
floral-powdery.pick: Dior Homme Intense if you're new to florals. Tempfluo for warm and easy, Café Rose for romantic, Hundred Silent Ways X when you want to be remembered.
